name_en: Great Gilt-bronze Incense Burner of Baekje
hook: A whole mountain smokes inside a ritual vessel.
summary_en: A phoenix, mountain lid, lotus body, and dragon base combine into Baekje’s most theatrical bronze object.
summary_ko: 봉황, 산악형 뚜껑, 연꽃 몸체, 용 받침이 한 몸을 이룬 백제 공예의 절정입니다.

sections.why_this_matters: No other object in the set carries so many worlds at once: scent, ritual, animals, music, immortals, mountains, and smoke.
sections.what_you_are_looking_at: The burner rises from a dragon base to a lotus bowl and a mountain-shaped lid topped by a phoenix. Small openings among the peaks let incense smoke drift through the landscape, animating the metal with air.
sections.the_story: Discovered at Neungsan-ri in Buyeo, the burner shows Baekje’s ability to absorb Buddhist and Daoist imagery into a distinct court style. It is ideal for a scroll page because every level rewards close looking.
